args.text: Can you pull together every site on Marrow Agrisupply you can find across #central-team? List each with where it comes from. Need it before the customer call.

Here's every Marrow Agrisupply site I could find in #central-team. There aren't many.

1. Eastbank: Hollis, Jun 9 2026 (10:46 AM). Ticket PD-4821 has Eastbank's receiving-door import attached. The file labels the doors E1/E2, but their booking sheet uses 01/02, so that needs sorting before anyone reimports and creates duplicates.

2. Pine Crossing: you, Jun 9 2026 (10:48 AM). The morning receiver's appointment screen only shows the afternoon shift. A driver who arrived at 7:10 got logged on a sticky note. Hollis said he'd check the shift template and get support to reproduce it with the store login.

3. Wichita store (probably Marrow, but not confirmed): you, Jul 2 2025 (9:21 AM). You mentioned an 8am check-in with the Wichita store dispatcher in the Zoom room that was hosting the Marrow Agrisupply office hours link. The thread doesn't actually say Wichita is a Marrow store, so please double-check before you use it.

Not Marrow: the Tulsa hub is Tansley Parcel, and Door 6 / #88412 is Tansleigh Packaging.

On Jun 9 you said three rows on Marrow's rollout tracker just say "waiting", but none of them are named in the channel. If you sent Hollis the per-store list, it isn't in #central-team, so I can't see it.
